content.text: No liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee provisions payable by Clear Capital appear anywhere in the agreement. Termination only obliges payment for fees and expenses actually incurred or earned.

input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, forfeiture, minimum-fee or early-termination fee payable by Clear Capital. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "stipulated", "minimum" and "forfeit" return nothing, and the compensation section (§ 3) imposes only time-and-materials fees, expenses and taxes with no late-payment penalty or interest. Termination under § 6(a) (convenience on 15 days' notice with no uncompleted SOW) and § 6(b)/7(c) requires only payment of fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the termination date, which is ordinary accrued-consideration language rather than a stipulated damages amount. This meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so no redline is warranted.
